what: A dark veil covers the hero. Two clumps of white steam from the top right and bottom left scatter outward 100px over 10 seconds (1.1x, fading to transparent), each layer twisting 5°. At 6.3s a large steam cloud in the center grows from .75x to 1.7x while turning 3° over 5s, blurring and covering the screen. At 10.01s (the length of the original steamer video) the veil lifts in .6s and scrolling is released — only once a day (localStorage)

options.dur: Length of the curtain cover (s), default 10.01 — 0 clears it immediately
options.big-at: When the large steam appears (sec), default 6.3
options.once: Hours before it shows again, default 24 — 0 means every time it opens
options.[data-fx-part=skip]: Skip button (if present, click to lift it right away)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Video slot behind the curtain (if present, the curtain lifts when that video ends instead of dur)

from.where: index.html .opening — original .top_page .opening: with steamer video playback, .yuge_tr·.yuge_bl get js-play (yuge_tr/bl 10s forwards: translate ±100px·scale 1.1·opacity 1→0, ::before 0→±5°, ::after -325→-330°), at currentTime ≥ 6.3 .yuge_all runs (opening_yuge_all 5s: scale .75→1.7 rotate 3deg·opacity 0→.5), on ended a .6s fade·openingPlayedAt 24 hours. In the original site the enabling flag (Ji) is always false, so it does not run now.

note: Fires an fx:done event on the element when finished. The steam clump is a soft radial gradient drawn by the part (the original is a steam photo)
